label: open-r1/OpenR1-Math-220k
description: A math/olympiad reasoning dataset — problem, solution, and answer fields joined into one text field — streamed and sampled to 5,000 documents.
highlight: Heavy LaTeX markup causes real content-type ambiguity: about 10% of documents (498 of 5,000) get classified as "code" by the whitespace-preservation heuristic, because LaTeX array/matrix blocks are line-structured the same way source code is. Concrete evidence for the "math" content-type gap discussed earlier — this dataset is the reason to actually build it.
facts: Math/olympiad problems — problem + solution + answer fields joined via --text-fields
